name: User-designed building
blurb: Bring a steel building you designed yourself — the Steltic building template or an ETABS .e2k model. HR Steel models it exactly as given (build-only: nothing resized, nothing invented, every missing key item asked), you confirm the model, and the Nonlinear module runs its full suite on it: pushover, NLRHA, DDM.

tabs.title: Your building
tabs.blurb: 1 Upload the template or the .e2k. 2 Answer what HR asks — key items have no default; proposed defaults are used only once you accept them, and are printed in every report. 3 HR builds the model (build-only). 4 Check the model in the 3-D viewer and confirm it. 5 Collect the specification values and run the full nonlinear suite. Every report is labelled “user-designed building: design basis supplied by the user, not checked by Steltic HR”.
